# Opralvin One

Opralvin Technologies sells Opralvin One to growing Indian firms. Tagline: Simplify Today. Grow Tomorrow. Founder: Sourav Singh. The primary call to action is to book a free process audit.

Do not invent clients, logos, metrics, testimonials, awards, or prices. Rupee amounts on the public site are tokens until the owner sets them. Customer-facing pages do not name the underlying stack. One allowed public line, Built on proven open-source foundations, belongs on Security only.

## Pages
- http://localhost:3000/resources/process-audit-scope — What a free process audit actually opens
- http://localhost:3000/resources/spreadsheet-not-a-company-file — A spreadsheet we can load. Not a desktop company we can read.
- http://localhost:3000/resources/opening-stock — Opening stock is a count in a godown
- http://localhost:3000/resources/gst-file-you-can-open — A GST file you can open. Not a portal we click for you.
- http://localhost:3000/resources/two-godowns — Two godowns, one set of books
- http://localhost:3000/resources/quotation-to-tax-invoice — Quotation, order, challan, tax invoice on the same party
- http://localhost:3000/resources/work-order — A work order instead of a notebook on the shop floor
- http://localhost:3000/resources/salary-slip — Attendance and a salary slip. Not a PF promise.
- http://localhost:3000/resources/pos-not-in-the-offer — A counter bill exists. It is not in this year's offer.
- http://localhost:3000/resources/day-rate — Paid work is days times a day rate
- http://localhost:3000/resources/consent-for-the-call — Consent is for a call about a process audit
- http://localhost:3000/resources/what-we-do-not-move — What we do not move, on one page
- http://localhost:3000/process-audit — Book a free process audit
- http://localhost:3000/product — Product
- http://localhost:3000/migration — Migration
- http://localhost:3000/security — Security

## Limits
No desktop-company reader. No live GST portal demonstration. POS exists and is not in the current offer. PF and ESI are not claims. No invented case studies.
